normalization: HTML br converted to line breaks; HTML entities unescaped; horizontal whitespace normalized. Original text retained separately.
variant_resolution: Longest text, then latest export filename; all variants retained in immutable originals and membership ledger.

interpretation: All regex flags are candidate retrieval aids. They can overlap and have false positives. Counts are corpus composition, not validated incidents, sentiment, demand or population prevalence. First-person flag is not ownership verification. A named-brand flag is not a comprehensive business-account classifier.
maps_selection: Lowest-ranking diagnostic and newest selected cohorts are separate memberships, not mutually exclusive people. Publication date is not visit date. No inferred transaction date.
youtube_time: Relative publication strings remain relative; no invented exact dates.
engagement: Export-time counts are retained, not weighting or population exposure.
originals: Unmodified raw exports are preserved by the enclosing repository archival pipeline.
